items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: I saw him, you know, when I was a kid play with Bebe.

ctx.x: Do you remember where you heard him?

Well he played, he played, I can't recall exactly, Henry Kimball. Well I thought he played with, he played with, what you call him, some, Bebe Risley. Oh yeah. He played some with Bebe, I saw him, you know, when I was a kid play with Bebe.
